column1: # L0 拒绝原因事实表:每行一个返回 -ENOSYS 的点的有名原因。tools/refusals-gen.cx --write 生成 cx/sys/refusals.cx(sy_refusal_reason 等);tools/enosys-sites.cx 按 origin(文件:函数)对账,一行登记抵该函数内一个无注释点。只追加:id 的数值是行序(从 1 起),删行或调序会改既有 id 值。

column4: fdatasync: the Windows prelude has no _commit or fdatasync binding
truncate: ftruncate is a POSIX call and _chsize_s is not bound on Windows
mkfifo: Windows has no FIFO special file
mkfifo: the macOS prelude has no mkfifo and no mknod syscall thunk yet
symlink: POSIX symlink has no Windows binding here
readlink: POSIX readlink has no Windows binding here
access: POSIX access has no Windows binding here
map: anonymous mmap is not bound on Windows (no VirtualAlloc path)
unmap: munmap is not bound on Windows (no VirtualFree path)
protect: mprotect is not bound on Windows (no VirtualProtect path)
